Class CollisionHandler

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core.CollisionSystem
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Handles collision detection, resolution, and spatial queries for registered CollisionObject instances. Implements IBounds to provide bounding information for the collision system.

public class CollisionHandler : IBounds

Remarks

This class manages the registration, update, and removal of collision objects, and provides methods for collision queries and spatial operations.

IntersectSpace(Collider, Vector2)

Performs an intersection query for a single Collider against the collision system.

public IntersectSpaceResult? IntersectSpace(Collider collider, Vector2 origin)

Parameters

collider Collider

The collider to test for intersections.

origin Vector2

The origin point for the intersection result.

Returns

IntersectSpaceResult

An IntersectSpaceResult containing intersection data, or null if no intersections are found.

Remarks

Only enabled colliders are considered for intersection checks in this query.

IntersectSpace(CollisionObject, Vector2)

Performs intersection queries for all colliders of a CollisionObject against the collision system.

public IntersectSpaceResult? IntersectSpace(CollisionObject colObject, Vector2 origin)

Parameters

colObject CollisionObject

The collision object whose colliders are used for intersection queries.

origin Vector2

The origin point for the intersection result.

Returns

IntersectSpaceResult

An IntersectSpaceResult containing intersection data, or null if no intersections are found.

Remarks

Only enabled colliders on colObject with ComputeIntersections set to true are used. Only enabled colliders are considered for intersection checks in this query.
